topics.title: Question Words
topics.subtitle: Ask for the information you need.
topics.subtitle_zh: 用問句詞找出你想知道的資料。

learning.intro: Question words are helper words at the start of a question. Look at the picture first, then choose the word that asks for the missing information.
learning.intro_zh: 問句詞放在問題的開頭，幫助我們詢問想知道的資料。先看圖片，再選擇最合適的問句詞。

cards.meaning: Ask about a thing or an action.
Ask about a time or day.
cards.meaning_zh: 詢問「何時／甚麼時候」：時間或日子。
詢問「哪一個」：從選項中選擇。

cards.meaning: Ask about a way, condition or amount.
cards.meaning_zh: 詢問「怎樣／如何」：方法、情況或程度。
cards.example: How do you get to school?

topics.title: Quantifiers
topics.subtitle: Choose words for number and amount.
topics.subtitle_zh: 選擇表示數量和份量的詞語。

learning.intro: First, sort the noun. Countable nouns can be counted one by one. Uncountable nouns are measured as an amount. Then choose a quantifier.
learning.intro_zh: 先分辨名詞。可數名詞可以逐一數；不可數名詞用份量來量度。然後選擇合適的數量詞。

cards.meaning: a small number of countable things
a small amount of uncountable things
cards.example: There is a little water in the large glass.
cards.example_zh: 這個大玻璃杯裡只有少量水。

cards.meaning: a large amount of an uncountable quantity
cards.meaning_zh: 很多／大量不可數的東西
cards.example: There is much water in the large glass.
cards.example_zh: 這個大玻璃杯裡有很多水。

cards.meaning_zh: 通常用於肯定句，表示「一些」

cards.meaning: usually used in questions and negative statements
cards.meaning_zh: 通常用於問句和否定句，表示「一些／任何」

questions.prompt: Choose the best words: We have ___ apples.
questions.why: Apples are countable, and the picture shows a small number.

questions.prompt: A large glass has only a small amount of water. Choose the best words.
questions.why: Water is uncountable. A little means a small amount.
Books can be counted one by one.
Rice is treated as an amount in this lesson.
Any is usually used in questions and negative statements.

questions.prompt: There are ___ grapes in the bowl.
questions.why: Grapes are countable, so many is the best choice.

questions.prompt: We need ___ juice for the picnic.
questions.why: This is a positive statement, so some is the usual choice.
Time is uncountable, so much is the best choice here.
